wave: Movie Studio Wave 5 — Production Intelligence & Cost-Efficient Filmmaking
scope: Integration preparation only. No Wave5 provider branch or integration branch is merged, deployed, enabled, or charged by this branch.
sourceBasis: The Last Seed acceptance plus the filmmaking workflow principles: lock references before expensive generation, treat takes as raw footage, salvage usable ranges before regenerating, generate minimal inserts, preserve continuity and screen direction, and draft cheaply before selected-only mastering.

decisions: preflight requires a non-empty Production Kit hash, locked references, ready shot, provider readiness, and draft budget allowance
usable segment ranges are selected before regeneration
uncovered time produces minimal insert proposals rather than whole-scene regeneration
continuity checks require a shared locked anchor and screen direction
budget optimization selects an economical draft source and reserves upgrade/mastering for the selected take
unknown cost remains unknown and is never interpreted as a customer charge
explicitNonGoals: no media mutation or pixel-level editing
no automatic approval, take selection, regeneration confirmation, or export execution

invariants: bounded package hash is stable across reload

journey: Create The Last Seed Full Movie fixture with locked Guide/Cast/World records
Approve storyboard and keyframe, then reload the bounded Production Kit
Run readiness/preflight and queue three independent economical source takes
Select usable ranges across takes and prove no regeneration is needed when coverage is complete
Create one minimal insert proposal for an uncovered tail and reject a screen-direction conflict
Approve/select/finalize exactly one take; block an alternate upgrade and accept selected-only upgrade/master hand-off
Generate deterministic voice and music test assets, persist/reload canonical timeline, and evaluate provider-neutral export
Assert provenance, no user-facing provider/model/prompt metadata, zero customer charge, and no fabricated export output
Run a separate provider-off Last Seed path and assert failed job, no Asset/output, and zero charge
determinism: no network generation or paid provider

migrationPlan.futureRule: If final Wave5 feature branches persist segment selections, salvage decisions, insert proposals, or budget decisions, compose one additive EF migration and regenerate the final snapshot after all model conflicts are reconciled. Never hand-edit migration history.
